sections.description:
Short title and commencement

SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
SINDH
IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999.
1.Short title and
commencement.‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Sindh Irrigation
(Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from Kharif, 1999.

Amendment of section 61 and 62 of Act VII of 1879

SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
SINDH
IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999.
2. Amendment of sections 61 and
62 of Act VII of 1879.‑In the Sindh Irrigation Act, 1879, hereinafter
referred to as the said act, in section 61, for the words "three
months", the words "two years" and for the words "one
thousand rupees", the words "three thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

Section 62

SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
SINDH
IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999.
3. In the said act, in section
62, for the words "one year", the words "three years" and
for the words "two thousand rupees", the words "five thousand
rupees" shall be substituted.

Section 62-A

SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
SINDH
IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999.
4. In the said Act, after section 62‑A, the following new section
shall be inserted.
"62‑B. Non‑bailable
offence. An offence punishable under section 61 or 62 shall be non‑bail
able.".
sections.punishment:
punishable under section 61 or 62 shall be non‑bail
able.

sections.description:
Abatement of certain orders or sanctions

SINDH IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
SINDH
IRRIGATION (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999.
5. Abatement of certain orders or sanctions.‑‑Notwithstanding any
thing contained in any law for the time being in force or any judgment or order
of any Court or agreement, the orders granting irrigation water through the
various canals to the various persons mentioned in the Schedule to this
Ordinance shall stand abrogated and annulled and be of no effect.
(2) No compensation shall be
claimed by or payable to any person who sustains any loss by such abrogation
and annulment.
/Note. For Schedule please see Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary Part 1,
dated 27‑3‑1999 pp. 189‑AC to 189‑AL]
